scope: Bottom-13 of the 12m ranking: BAJFINANCE TATACAP BAJAJFINSV PERSISTENT ETERNAL PRESTIGE JIOFIN LENSKART YESBANK MEESHO TCS AUBANK TECHM
method: Read the stock reports, profiles and rankings after the RT_EVENTS and RT_BACKBONE merge (08:31). Decomposed forward exposure by the final company edge and by entry node, and computed the implied expected forward driver moves (repo, 10y, VIX, S&P). Checked edges against the empirical pack and against prices on the 7-8 Oct hike days. Fetched news for Q2 results, AT1, ECL, IT visa and MSCI. Re-ran mi/graph.run on a redirected scratch output with all proposals below, with no files in results/ touched.

edge_scale.reason: Profile's own arithmetic gives -1.2 (Rs376cr floating-funding cost + rollover = -2.5% EBT x persistence 0.5). The mechanism then adds 'P/E de-rating at 34x' to reach -3. That multiple channel is already the F_GSEC_10Y_IN edge (-2.5, 'cost of equity at P/E 34x') and the REPO -> GSEC (0.53) -> BAJFINANCE path. Keep the fundamental -1.2. Evidence: on 7-8 Oct (hike to 5.50%) BAJFINANCE fell -0.7% against Nifty -2.4%.

Mechanism computes -0.8 (Rs860cr = -3.2% PBT, 50% pass-through, persistence 0.5). It then lifts this to -5 for a 'multiple effect', which is the same discount-rate channel as the GSEC edge. 0.4 gives -2.0, still 2.5x the arithmetic.

Empirical market-adjusted elasticity +0.01 per +5 VIX (t 0.04, 156 weeks, results/empirical_sensitivities.csv). The -2 is market beta, which the beta adjustment already removes. Forward catalogue VIX expectation is +1.5 SSU, so this edge alone books about -2.8 pp of forward exposure.

Own arithmetic is -0.8 (Rs330cr = -3.3% PBT, half re-priced through floating LAP/corporate/EBLR assets, persistence 0.5). The 'P/E 24.5x multiple effect' that lifts it to -3 duplicates the GSEC edge (-2.5) and the REPO->GSEC path. Q2 FY27 PAT rose 51% to Rs1,660cr and the stock gained 5% (ET 27-28 Oct).
+50bp on Rs0.96 lakh cr = Rs480cr = 4.8% PBT, 50% passed through, persistence 0.5 gives -1.2. The -4 includes a multiple add-on already carried by the GSEC edge. 0.5 gives -2.
Look-through of BAJFINANCE's inflated -3 (x0.75). It is scaled with the BAJFINANCE fix; insurance float gains from higher yields offset further.
Look-through of BAJFINANCE -5 (x0.8). It inherits the same multiple double count, so it gets the same scale as BAJFINANCE (0.4).
Empirical market-adjusted elasticity -0.18 per +5 VIX (t -0.58). The -2 restates beta 1.06-1.14.

Mechanism: '+5 VIX ~ Nifty -3.5%; beta 1.47-1.57 ... -> -5'. This is market beta and is double counted with the beta adjustment. Empirical market-adjusted elasticity is +0.11 (t 0.26). The edge was the largest single forward channel (EV_AI_CAPEX_RESET_RISK -16.9% conditional for JIOFIN). -1 keeps a small growth-duration premium.
Own arithmetic -1.5 (NIM -6bp on Rs2.9 lakh cr, persistence 0.5). The mechanism 'doubled for discount-rate effect', which is the GSEC edge plus the REPO->GSEC path.

The mechanism books AFS MTM (Rs250cr) as a P&L hit. Under RBI's 2023 investment-portfolio directions (effective Apr 2024; model knowledge), AFS unrealised losses go to the AFS reserve in equity, not P&L. The remaining channels are a small CET1 effect and discount rate.

Own arithmetic -0.9 (net -Rs77cr = -1.8% PBT, persistence 0.5), plus a 'P/E 22x multiple effect' that duplicates the GSEC edge and path. Kept at -1.5 because the Q2 call (24 Oct) flagged margin pressure. The stock fell 8-10% on 26 Oct, and that move is in the realised return.

Mechanism splits -4 into PAT -2.0, demand -0.6 and multiple -1.4. Demand is the separate REPO -> F_HOUSING_DEMAND (-0.26) -> PRESTIGE (+5) path. The multiple is the GSEC edge (-1.0, cap rates and resi discounting) plus the REPO->GSEC path. Keep about -2.4.

Discount-rate channel (P/E ~700, Gordon 0.25/(r-g)) applies the full 25bp to a 25-year duration. Long yields move about 0.53x repo (backbone REPO->GSEC edge), so the duration effect belongs to the long rate. The forward catalogue's +62bp repo path (see findings) makes this edge -6 pp of forward exposure.
Empirical market-adjusted elasticity +0.67 per +5 VIX (t 1.15, wrong sign). The profile's -2.5 is mostly beta (1.1-1.3).

Contradicted by the profile's own data: FII holding rose 29.1% -> 33.0% (Jun-Sep 2026) during the record FPI outflow, and the stock is +39% market-adjusted since June. A broad-flow beta of +3.5 books -5.6% of 'unpriced' recent impact that did not happen.
Same as ETERNAL: Gordon duration on a 25bp short-rate move. Long-rate beta to repo is about 0.53.
No empirical history (listed Nov 2025). -3 'after market component' is not supported; peer ETERNAL's empirical value is +0.67. Halved.

FII holding rose 4.3% -> 18.3% in two quarters while aggregate FPI flows were at a record outflow. Stock-level flows are block supply from pre-IPO holders, not the macro FPI node. The stock is at an all-time high (+11% on 5 Nov after Q2).
Same duration logic as ETERNAL/LENSKART. Long-rate beta to repo is about 0.53.
-4 'after market component' has no empirical support (listed Dec 2025). Peer ETERNAL's empirical value is +0.67. Halved.

Output-gap reaction edge (0.8 SSU = 20bp per 1pp GDP). Summed over about 90 independent forward events, it turns good-growth news hawkish. EV_MONSOON27_FIRST_FORECAST_NORMAL adds +0.26 SSU expected repo, although a normal monsoon lowers food inflation. EV_BUDGET27_CAPEX_RAILWAY adds +0.31 SSU. Propagated repo moves total +1.35 SSU of the catalogue's +2.46 SSU (+62bp) 12m expectation, against +0.59 SSU from the explicit MPC events. The explicit Dec/Feb/Apr MPC odds (RT_EVENTS) already condition on growth and inflation. This is the same treatment RT_BACKBONE gave CPI->REPO (x0.5): RT_BACKBONE did not cover this edge, so there is no duplicate.

The breach event's own F_REPO_IN +0.4 SSU (p 0.6) books the same hike a second time. Keeping F_REPO_IN in entry_shocks at 0 clamps it, so CPI->REPO no longer propagates inside this event. EV_RBI_GOLD_LOAN_TIGHTEN.reason: Node conflation. A gold-loan/revolving-credit rule is booked as a full system-wide P_RBI_PRUDENTIAL step (+1 = risk-weight-type tightening). Current conditional impacts are TATACAP -6.5, BAJFINANCE -6.1, AUBANK -5.7, YESBANK -5.6, SBIN -4.5 and HDFCBANK -4.3, larger than the gold lender MUTHOOTFIN (-5.0). Gold loans are <2% of BAJFINANCE AUM (profile). TATACAP says revolving-credit curbs touch 3-4% of AUM and that rule is already a TATACAP company event (ET BFSI 28 Oct). Keep 0.3 for NBFC spill-over and move the gold-lender hit to a MUTHOOTFIN company entry. Prob unchanged.

offset: NBFC, outside the bank ECL directions
offset: NBFC/CIC, outside the bank ECL directions

EV_ECL_ROLLOUT_APR27.reason: RT_EVENTS shocks and probability kept unchanged (0 / 0.9). Added company-entry offsets that cancel the generic-node impact on NBFCs. The 27 Apr 2026 RBI directions apply to commercial banks. NBFCs have used Ind AS 109 ECL since FY2018 with no regulatory floor; BAJFINANCE ECL coverage is 2.0% against the bank-floor-equivalent 1.2% (Kotak via ETBFSI, 2 May 2026). The event currently books BAJFINANCE -1.98, TATACAP -2.41, JIOFIN -1.08 and BAJAJFINSV -1.67 conditional. Offsets equal these, net of the BAJFINANCE -> BAJAJFINSV 0.75 holding link. Cleaner alternative for the Director: give ECL a bank-only node.

entry_shocks.note: halved: the S-1 news already moved Indian IT -2 to -5% on 27-28 Oct (event's own description)

EV_ANTHROPIC_IPO_LISTING.reason: The event's own description records that the S-1 news already moved Indian IT -2 to -5% on 27-28 Oct. The listing itself (p 0.85) should add only the residual substitution narrative. T_GENAI 0.5 -> 0.25, which cuts TCS/TECHM about -1.25 pp to about -0.6 pp expected. Prob unchanged.

recent_state_overrides.reason: Event sum 0.9 (EV_INDIAN_IT_Q2_VISA_SHOCK 0.5 + EV_H1B_100K_FEE_COURT 0.4). Both include the H-1B fee, so it is double counted. Since 1 Jun the $100k fee was blocked by a second US judge (ET 1 Oct), and USCIS is clearing H-1B petitions without the fee (NDTV Profit 26 Oct). Analysts see little risk from the green-card (PERM) suspension because PERM filings were already falling (Reuters 11 Oct; ET 10 Oct). The Democratic midterm win lowers odds of a statutory tightening. Net change since June: green-card freeze plus the OPT fee proposal, about 0.35 of a 'material tightening'.

Single source: EV_IT_AI_DEFLATION_Q2FY27 +1.0, whose what_already_moved is 'Not quantified'. AI-driven pricing deflation is a LEVEL narrative that was priced before June: TCS was ~-35% in 2026 before October and -16.7% over 12m. Since June the market moved the other way. Nifty IT rose +16% in a month to 22 Oct on the 'anti-AI trade' (Upstox 22 Oct; CNBC TV18 13 Oct), and TCS (+4.1%) and TECHM (+14%) beat the market since 1 Jun. The incremental Q2 evidence (Infosys guidance cut to 1-2%, 23 Oct) supports a small change, about 0.3.

findings.subject: F_REPO_IN forward path (all rate-sensitive names)
findings.issue: Rate channel double counted across forward events. The catalogue implies an expected +2.46 SSU (+62bp) repo move over 12m, on top of the 7 Oct hike. The explicit MPC events (Dec 0.42, Feb 0.27, Apr cut 0.10) give +0.59 SSU (+15bp). Other events with explicit repo shocks add +0.52 (CPI breach, rupee break, stagflation). Propagation through CPI->REPO and GDP->REPO adds +1.35, including +0.26 from a NORMAL monsoon forecast and +0.31 from budget capex. The expected 10y G-sec move is +1.91 SSU (+48bp). Street forecasts are flat to lower: 7.25-7.35% for November (ET BFSI 4 Nov) and 6.75-7.0% by March per SBI Research (BS 1 Nov). F_REPO_IN is the largest final edge in forward exposure for BAJFINANCE (-6.2), TATACAP (-6.3), YESBANK, AUBANK, PRESTIGE and ETERNAL. Fixes proposed: GDP->REPO x0.4 (edge_scale), REPO clamps in EV_CPI_BREACH_6PCT and EV_PULSES_VEG_SPIKE_WINTER (event_overrides). Preferred engine fix: clamp F_REPO_IN in every non-RBI forward event dated before the last explicit MPC event (Apr 2027), so the MPC odds alone carry the policy path.

findings.subject: Company REPO/CREDIT_SPREADS edges (BAJFINANCE, TATACAP, BAJAJFINSV, YESBANK, AUBANK, PRESTIGE)
findings.issue: Within-profile duplicate channel. Each mechanism computes the funding-cost effect (-0.8 to -1.5), then adds a 'P/E / multiple / discount-rate' layer to reach -2.5 to -5. Each profile also carries an F_GSEC_10Y_IN discount-rate edge, and the backbone REPO->GSEC (0.53) path re-enters it (half-damped). Scaled in edge_scale to the agents' own fundamental numbers. On the hike days (7-8 Oct) BAJFINANCE fell -0.7%, TATACAP -2.2% and BAJAJFINSV -2.5%, against Nifty -2.4%. The market did not price the -4 to -5% hike impact these edges imply.

findings.subject: EV_ECL_ROLLOUT_APR27 -> NBFCs
findings.issue: The bank ECL rollout is routed through generic nodes (P_RBI_PRUDENTIAL, F_ASSET_QUALITY_IN, F_CREDIT_GROWTH_IN), so it hits NBFCs that are outside the directions: BAJFINANCE -1.98, TATACAP -2.41, JIOFIN -1.08, BAJAJFINSV -1.67 conditional at p 0.9. NBFCs have applied Ind AS 109 ECL since FY2018 and already meet bank-style floors (BFL coverage 2.0% vs 1.2%). Offsets added in event_overrides. The cleaner fix is a bank-only ECL node.

findings.subject: mi/graph.py unpriced-recent rule (opposite-sign realised moves)
findings.issue: When the realised market-adjusted move has the opposite sign to the model impact, the full model impact is kept as 'unpriced'. BAJFINANCE: model -10.0, realised +14.3, unpriced -10.0. Same pattern for TATACAP (-9.7 vs +9.7), PRESTIGE, PERSISTENT, TCS, TECHM and MEESHO. This means the macro hit is still to come and the stock had an offsetting idiosyncratic surprise of +24pp. BAJFINANCE's Q2 (PAT +29%, AUM guidance +4pp) met previews, and NBFCs as a group outperformed (CHOLAFIN +12.3 market-adjusted). More likely the sensitivity is overstated or the shocks were anticipated. Proposal: if sign(realised) != sign(model) and |realised| > |model|, cap the unpriced share at 0.5 x model unless a dated stock-specific event of matching size is documented. This rule is not in my proposals or my simulated numbers. Applied, it would roughly halve the remaining unpriced -6.9/-7.2 for BAJFINANCE/TATACAP.

findings.subject: Forward catalogue global-risk skew (IT and high-beta names)
findings.issue: Summed over forward events, the expected 12m moves are F_US_EQUITIES -1.95 SSU (S&P -9.75%) and F_RISK_SENTIMENT +1.49 SSU (VIX +7.5 pts). They come from EV_AI_CAPEX_RESET_RISK, EV_US_RECESSION_RISK_2027 and EV_YEN_CARRY_UNWIND_RISK, with no upside counterpart (only EV_NVDA_NOV17_BEAT +0.4 SSU S&P). After my fixes this skew is the main remaining driver of PERSISTENT/TCS/TECHM forward exposure: US_EQUITIES edges are empirically supported (+1.07 to +2.15), so the edges are fine and the expectation is skewed. Recommend that the Director/RT_EVENTS add a balancing upside scenario (e.g. AI-capex re-acceleration / soft landing, S&P +3 SSU, VIX -1.5 SSU) or demean global risk nodes across the catalogue.

findings.subject: F_RISK_SENTIMENT company edges include market beta
findings.issue: Several profiles write the VIX edge as beta x market fall, which double counts with the ranking's beta adjustment. Empirical market-adjusted elasticities: BAJFINANCE +0.01 (t 0.04), BAJAJFINSV -0.18 (t -0.58), JIOFIN +0.11 (t 0.26), ETERNAL +0.67 (t 1.15). Edges are -2, -2, -5 and -2.5. Scaled for my names. A universe-wide check of RISK edges against the empirical pack is worth doing.

findings.subject: YESBANK missing company event: Rs7,500cr equity raise
findings.issue: Missing stock-specific channel. The 4 Nov AGM sought approval for up to Rs7,500cr equity and Rs8,500cr debt after the Supreme Court voided the Rs8,415cr AT1 write-off (Reuters 15 Oct; ~250bp CET1, The Hindu 16 Oct). That is about 15% dilution at a ~Rs50k cr market cap. The AT1 hit is priced (stock -26% in October; model correctly books unpriced 0). Pricing-discount dilution is not priced yet. FIX: company_event_overrides add {ticker: YESBANK, date: '2027-02', event: 'Equity raise up to Rs7,500cr (QIP/preferential): pricing discount and ~15% dilution', type: corporate_action, prob: 0.7, impact_pct_low: -5, impact_pct_high: 0}.

findings.subject: BAJFINANCE
findings.issue: VERDICT: too high — Model -13.8% 12m / -8.0% 3m (rank 200) is about 2x too negative; with my fixes it is about -6.4% / -4.2% (rank 197). Drivers: unpriced recent -10.0 against a realised +14.3 (opposite sign, see the engine finding), and forward -14.8. The forward part is dominated by F_REPO_IN (-6.2 pp), GSEC (-3.8) and SPREADS (-3.2). These are inflated by the +62bp implied repo path, the REPO/SPREADS edge multiple double count, ECL (NBFC-exempt) and gold-loan node conflation. A negative tilt is defensible: hiking cycle, the Q2 call flagged margins, Rs17,500cr raise. No single edge or event exceeds ±25%; the largest conditional is Iran escalation at about -10%. Recent run: Q2 PAT +29%, FY27 AUM guidance raised to 27% (19 Oct), +7% on 5 Nov with oil -18% for the week.
